# AI and Technology

## Current State

Humanistic AI practice is strongest when models operate inside explicit, inspectable workflows and people retain responsibility for evidence, quality, and authorship.

## Cross-source Findings

### Human Accountability Bounds Ai Workflows

[[AIWorkflowForHumanitiesWorkers]] and [[AIProductionPipeline]] make reliability depend on traceable steps, explicit standards, and retained human judgment.
